about.excerpt: Vision Studios, your premier destination for high-quality broadcast studio rentals in London, Dublin, Paris and Istanbul. We are proud to offer fully equipped, modern studios for a wide range of broadcast productions.
blocks: With over 25 years of experience in the industry, we have built a reputation for excellence in both the quality of our facilities and our customer service. Our knowledgeable and friendly staff are always on hand to help you make the most of our studios, whether you are producing live news broadcasts, television shows, corporate advertising or other types of broadcast content.

Our vision is to be the leading provider of broadcast studio rentals in the world. We aim to set the standard for quality, innovation, and excellence in the industry, providing our clients with cutting-edge technology and world-class facilities that meet their every need. We strive to be a company that is not only successful but also socially responsible, using our resources to support the creative arts and to make a positive impact on the communities where we operate. Ultimately, our vision is to help our clients tell their stories in a way that inspires, entertains, and informs audiences around the world.

At Vision Studios, our mission is to provide our clients with the highest-quality broadcast studio rentals in the industry. We strive to be a reliable and trusted partner to broadcasters, television producers, and other creative professionals, offering them state-of-the-art facilities, top-notch equipment, and exceptional customer service. Our goal is to help our clients bring their creative visions to life by providing them with the tools they need to produce exceptional content.
In addition to our state-of-the-art equipment and well-maintained facilities, we offer a wide range of services to meet all your production needs. Our team of:
are experts in their fields and will ensure that your broadcast runs smoothly from start to finish.

If you need a custom set design for your production, our experienced set designer team can work with you to create a set that meets your exact specifications. We can handle everything from the initial design concept to the final manufacturing and installation of your set.

We invite you to come and experience our broadcast studios for yourself and see why so many creative professionals choose our studios as their go-to destination for high-quality studio spaces. Contact us today to schedule a tour or to learn more about our rental options in London, Dublin, and Istanbul.

At Vision Studios, we are more than just a studio rental company – we are a community of creatives who share a passion for excellence in all aspects of our work. We are proud to have created a space where broadcasters and professionals can come together to collaborate, share ideas, and support one another in the pursuit of their goals.
Committed To Keep People Healthy & Safe

At Vision Studios, we prioritize the health and safety of our clients, staff, and guests. We have implemented strict sanitation and social distancing protocols to protect against COVID-19 and regularly sanitize and disinfect our facilities. By keeping people healthy and safe, we create a positive and productive environment that fosters creativity and collaboration.

At Vision Studios, we are committed to following best practices in the broadcast industry. We prioritize quality, safety, and professionalism in all aspects of our operations and adhere to strict safety protocols. We also prioritize sustainability and environmental responsibility by using energy-efficient equipment and employing eco-friendly practices. By following best practices, we provide high-quality services and make a positive impact on the world around us.

posts.title: Documentary Filmmaking at Vision Studios
posts.excerpt: The Art of Documentary Filmmaking at Vision Studios At Vision Studios, documentary filmmaking reaches new heights through a precise fusion…
paragraphs: The Art of Documentary Filmmaking at Vision Studios

At Vision Studios, documentary filmmaking reaches new heights through a precise fusion of storytelling and technical mastery. The creative team designed an intimate interview environment using a deep black backdrop to draw focus solely onto the subject. Using the Alexa camera, they captured every nuance with striking clarity, and a thoughtfully placed video projector layered visual interest into the scene.

Cinematic dolly movements added subtle motion, enriching the visual rhythm without distracting from the message. Expert lighting sculpted each face with care, emphasising emotion and depth. Under the direction of a visionary filmmaker, these carefully orchestrated elements transformed simple interviews into deeply engaging and emotionally resonant narratives, all part of an upcoming documentary destined to captivate.

posts.title: Vision Studios Creates Gripping Greenpeace Video for Domino
posts.excerpt: Major international studio and facilities enterprise Vision Studios was chosen by Domino Productions to host a powerful four minute video for Greenpeace MENA
paragraphs: Major international studio and facilities enterprise Vision Studios was chosen by Domino Productions to host a powerful four minute video for Greenpeace MENA. The production was hosted in the MediaCity Studios in Istanbul.

The video is a rap battle between an industrialist and an environmentalist, arguing about the way that energy exploitation has a hugely unfair impact on the poorer countries of the global south. The video smoothly transitions between the television studio, boardroom, and city streets. All in Arabic, it is aimed at the Middle East and North Africa region.

Vision Studios has fully equipped broadcast studios in London, Dublin, Paris and Istanbul. Available for long-term rent or for one-off projects, they are fully crewed and equipped with the latest technology. Operating for 25 years, Vision Studios serves more than 1000 productions each year.

“I had worked with Vision Studios in Istanbul, Dublin and London,” said Ali Shehata, the project’s producer at Domino Production. “I knew the sort of quality they could deliver. The Istanbul MediaCity location gave us a lot of options in one place, including many locations as well as the studio set. If you work in media production, you should collaborate with Vision Studios.”

Gerard Kirwan, Director of Sales at Vision Studios added “We have huge experience in video production, so we work very comfortably with creative businesses like Domino Production. Our in-house technical, design and craft services support them, so we deliver the best results, on time and on budget. This video for Greenpeace MENA looks and sounds great – it is a really arresting way to get over an important message.”

Domino Production is based in Istanbul, Turkey and Doha, Qatar. Greenpeace MENA is the newest element in the Greenpeace network, which now numbers 27 independent national and regional organisations working with the joint co-ordinating organisation, Greenpeace International.
You can watch the video in full here.
